fills.researcher_notes: ONE-QUESTION-PER-COMPANY: same GSPL operator finding as the rest of this brief (see P0927 for the full reasoning), but graded medium rather than high for THIS row specifically: unlike P0927/P0937/P3909, I could not find a project-specific independent (non-GSPL) origin naming GSPL as developer/operator of this exact line. GSPL's own FY2023-24 Annual Report calls it the 'Chhara LNG Connectivity pipeline (90 Km Approx.)' under 'Projects under execution' — first-party, not independent. Trade press (World Pipelines, Pipeline & Gas Journal, Hydrocarbon Engineering, Tanks & Terminals) uniformly reports 'developed by Gujarat State Petronet Limited (GSPL)' commissioning the line 20 March 2025, but all of these trace to the same GSPL press release, so per the corroboration rule they count as one origin, not several. A Ministry of Road Transport & Highways right-of-way listing (morth.gov.in) is titled around a '36" Dia Carrier Pipe ... from GSPL's Lothpur CNG Station ... to Chhara LNG Terminal' but the page did not render readable body text on fetch, so I am not citing it — noting it only as a lead a human could chase for a second independent source. Only the general CARE Ratings statement is independently verified for this specific row, hence tier=medium, not high.

validity.recommendation: Do not change LengthKnownKm (85 km) on current evidence — the best available independent figures cluster close to it, not to the drawn route's 115 km. A human should try to get an exact as-built length from GSPL (investor presentation or a BSE/NSE commissioning filing for the 20-Mar-2025 commissioning) before touching either value; failing that, have the geojson reviewed, since GSPL's own materials describe the route as skirting the Gir National Park eco-sensitive zone, which could plausibly explain a route that is not a straight line without necessarily being 115 km.
validity.researcher_notes: Two independent-of-GSPL figures for this same Chhara–Lothpur connectivity line cluster near the sheet's 85 km rather than the drawn route's 115 km: a 2018 PNGRB-era proposal reported at 86.61 km (cost Rs622cr), and GSPL's own FY2023-24 Annual Report gives 'Chhara LNG Connectivity pipeline (90 Km Approx.)' (first-party, but an audited statutory filing, not a press quote). Neither is precise enough to justify overwriting 85.00 with a new exact figure — both are approximate/'circa' and one predates the final as-built route — but both undercut the case that 115 km (the drawn geodesic length, ratio 1.35) is the more accurate figure. I could not locate a definitive as-built length in a commissioning announcement (World Pipelines, PGJ, Hydrocarbon Engineering, Tanks & Terminals all report diameter/capacity/cost/route but omit total km) or in the PNGRB NGPL register, which does not itemise this line at all in either the October-2025 or May-2026 editions — consistent with the register's stated scope of common-carrier lines only; this HPCL-LNG-terminal connectivity spur may be a dedicated/tie-in line, which the register's own coverage note excludes from itemisation. Marking UNRESOLVED on the specific length correction, but with enough evidence to recommend against 'fixing' the sheet toward the drawn route.
